description: Header file defining the Tokenizer class and related enums for tokenizing input files in the GN build system.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: Class responsible for tokenizing input files, handling whitespace transformations, and classifying tokens.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Static method to tokenize an input file into a vector of tokens.

methods.name: ByteOffsetOfNthLine
methods.description: Counts lines in a buffer and returns the byte offset of the start of the nth line.

methods.name: IsNewline
methods.description: Checks if a given offset in a buffer corresponds to a newline character.

methods.name: IsIdentifierFirstChar
methods.description: Checks if a character can be the first character of an identifier.

methods.name: IsIdentifierContinuingChar
methods.description: Checks if a character can continue an identifier.

methods.name: ClassifyToken
methods.description: Classifies a token based on the next and following characters.
